title: Man Is World-forming: The Thematic Exposition of the Problem of World — Manifestness, the 'As', the Apophantic Logos, and Projection

work.full: The Fundamental Concepts of Metaphysics: World, Finitude, Solitude

location.chapter_title: The Thematic Exposition of the Problem of World through an Examination of the Thesis That 'Man Is World-forming'
location.page_offset_formula: pdf = floor((book_page + 24) / 2); GA brackets read from running heads (non-linear)

spine_role: Culminating 'map' unit of Part Two: the world-question, explicitly returned (§67) to the direction disclosed by the interpretation of profound boredom, is unfolded through the manifestness of beings as such as a whole, the 'as'-structure, a long Aristotle-anchored interpretation of the apophantic logos (synthesis/diairesis, apophansis, the copula), and finally projection (Entwurf) as the primordial tripartite structure of world-formation. World = manifestness/disclosure is here given its deepest formulation, tying world-formation back to attunement-as-disclosure.

sections.title: The primary characteristics of the phenomenon of world: the manifestness of beings as beings and the 'as'; the relation to beings as letting be and not letting be (comportment, orientation, selfhood)
The undifferentiated manifestness of the various kinds of beings that are present at hand; the slumbering of Dasein's fundamental relationships toward beings in everydayness
The manifestness proper to living nature, and the transposedness of Dasein into the encircling contextual ring of living beings

The question concerning the occurrence of manifestness as the point of departure for the world-question; return of the world-question to the direction disclosed by the interpretation of profound boredom
Provisional delimitation of the concept of world: world as the manifestness of beings as such as a whole; general elucidation of world-formation
A first formal interpretation of the 'as' as a structural moment of manifestness; the orientation of metaphysics toward the logos as why the problem of world was not unfolded originarily
A fundamental methodological consideration: two fundamental forms of misinterpretation of metaphysical concepts; formal indication
The task of returning to the originary dimension of the 'as', taking an interpretation of the structure of the propositional statement as point of departure
Outline of the propositional statement (logos apophantikos) in Aristotle: semainein, the symbolon, apophansis, synthesis/diairesis, the 'as'-structure, onoma/rhema, the copula

Return to the ground of the possibility of the structure of assertion as a whole: pre-logical / pre-predicative manifestness, being free for beings, and the tripartite occurrence (holding-toward-the-binding, completion, unveiling the being of beings)
World-formation as the fundamental occurrence in Dasein; the essence of world as the prevailing of world
The 'as a whole' as the world, and the enigmatic distinction between being and beings (the ontological difference, in nine points)
Projection (Entwurf) as the primordial structure of the tripartite fundamental occurrence of world-formation; world prevails in the projection of world that lets it prevail

key_terms.term: manifestness of beings as such as a whole
key_terms.gloss: Heidegger's positive determination of world: not the totality of beings, not their mere accessibility, but the manifestness of beings as beings, as a whole — disclosure as the essence of world.
World; not the sum of beings in themselves but the manifestness within which beings can be encountered as beings; correlate of world-formation.

World-forming; the thesis 'man is world-forming' read so that the Dasein in man, not the man 'running around in the street', forms world — in a deliberately threefold sense: brings forth, gives an image/sets forth, constitutes/embraces.
The enigmatic 'as' (a as b), a structural moment of manifestness refused to the animal; first formally a relation, then traced back through the apophantic logos to its originary ground in projection.
The 'as a whole' first made enigmatic in the boredom analysis; the whole out of and into which every assertion speaks; the prior forming of which is 'completion'; identified in §75 with world.

The relation to beings governed by letting-be (and so by the possibility of not-letting-be), distinguished from the captivated behaviour (Benehmen) of the animal; presupposes restraint (Verhaltenheit) and stance (Haltung), hence selfhood.

The propositional/exhibiting discourse that points out (apophansis); the only logos that can be true or false; read from Aristotle's De Interpretatione as the form whose ground the interpretation pursues.
Giving-something-to-be-understood; the general essence of all logos (semantikos), forming a sphere of understandability — wider than apophansis, which is one kind of meaningful discourse.

Hinge/joint where two things are held to one another so as to fit (the two halves of a guest-friends' ring); language is kata syntheken (by agreement), grounded in the genesis of a symbolon — which Heidegger reads as nothing other than transcendence.

Taking-together that is at once a taking-apart; the unitary apprehending (synthesis noematon) Aristotle locates as the ground of the logos' possibility of revealing/concealing; Heidegger reads it as what he calls the 'as'-structure.
Pointing-out / letting beings be seen as what and how they are; either kataphasis (pointing toward) or apophasis (pointing away); not limited to the now but covers past and future being.
Revealing (taking-from-concealment) / being-deceptive; the either/or whose possibility (not mere presence) constitutes the inner essence of the apophantic logos; grounded in synthesis-diairesis.
Name (noun) / saying (verb, Zeitwort); distinguished by time — the rhema co-signifies time (prossemainein chronon); the 'is' as copula co-signifies a synthesis.

The structural moment of the assertion that co-signifies (prossemainein) a synthesis; its undifferentiated manifold of what-being, that-being and being-true is the primary essence of the copula — the hinge into the question of being.

The manifestness of beings as such that lies prior to the assertion and grounds its possibility of being true or false ('pre-logical truth'); the assertion only takes apart (legt auseinander) what is already manifest.

The logos apophantikos is an ability (Vermögen) — having a relation to beings as such at one's disposal — possible only where there is freedom; being free for beings as such grounds the either/or of truth and falsity.

The prior forming of the 'as a whole' (rendered 'completion'): not adding a missing piece but seeing and forming the whole in advance, as in craftsmanship; the second moment of the originary dimension of the assertion.

The distinction between being and beings, set out in nine points: not made by us but happening to us as a fundamental occurrence of Dasein; the central moment from which the problem of world is comprehended.

Projection: the primordial structure that originarily unifies the three moments of the fundamental occurrence; an originary action that raises whoever projects away into the possible-as-made-possible; 'projection is world-projection' — in it world prevails.

key_terms.term: Walten der Welt / the prevailing of world
key_terms.gloss: The essence of world named positively: world prevails in and for a letting-prevail that has the character of projecting; more originary than the beings that press upon us; can only be prepared, never effected.

The thoroughgoing character of philosophical (esp. fundamental) concepts: they do not directly intend their referent but point whoever understands toward a transformation into his or her own Dasein; hence never to be taken as present-at-hand or in isolation.

Resolute disclosedness (Entschlossenheit) as the moment of vision of genuine action; invoked in §70 against the misreading of being-toward-death as a present-at-hand state; its seldomness and ecstatic expanse are missed by ordinary understanding.

claims.text: World belongs to world-formation: 'the manifestness of beings as such as a whole, world, forms itself, and world only is what it is in such formation.' World is not the totality of beings, not their accessibility, not the manifestness underlying that accessibility — world is the manifestness of beings as such as a whole.

The 'as' (something as something) is refused to the animal; only where beings are manifest as beings is there the possibility of experiencing this or that as determined thus — and of letting-be, hence of not-letting-be, hence of comportment, stance, and selfhood.

In everydayness beings are manifest in a levelled-out undifferentiatedness (tram, people, dog, stars 'all in the same way'); this most powerful, all-too-self-evident phenomenon is 'the deadly enemy of philosophy', and within it the fundamental relationships of Dasein toward beings slumber.

The world-question is to be developed in the direction disclosed through the interpretation of profound boredom as a fundamental attunement: attunement makes beings as a whole manifest and makes us manifest to ourselves as disposed in their midst — Dasein becomes manifest to itself.

The problem of world, where world means the manifestness of beings as such as a whole, finds itself led back to logic; logic has thereby seemed the proper basis of metaphysics — an ossified self-evidence whose limited legitimacy must be exposed by returning to the originary dimension of the 'as'.

All philosophical concepts are formally indicative: they do not directly intend what they refer to but point whoever understands toward a transformation into his or her Dasein; taken without their indicative character (as present-at-hand, in isolation) they become a starting point for groundless questions.

Only the logos apophantikos can be true or false; what makes it apophantic is that aletheuein or pseudesthai 'lies in it as underlying it'. Even concealing is a pointing-out: the tendency to point out grounds both revealing and concealing.

Aristotle grounds the possibility of revealing/concealing in a synthesis noematon hosper hen onton — a unity-forming apprehension (nous, noein): 'where there is deception there we find such apprehending formation of a unity.' This apprehending is intrinsically also diairesis: a taking-together that takes-apart.

What Aristotle treats under synthesis is what Heidegger calls the 'as'-structure: the 'as' is not a property of the logos grafted onto it, but conversely is in general the condition of the possibility of the logos apophantikos; syn (together / whole) shows the 'as'-structure's essential connection to the 'as a whole'.

The 'is' (copula) co-signifies (prossemainein) a synthesis and is not a real predicate (so too Kant) — its undifferentiated, universal manifold of what-being, that-being, and being-true is the originary and primary essence of the copula, from which particular meanings arise only by limitation. Metaphysics is decided by our position toward the problem of the copula.

The assertion is neither originary nor independent: it never primarily reveals beings as such but only takes apart (legt auseinander) what is already manifest; the blackboard must already be manifest for us to assert anything about it. Propositional truth is therefore not the fundamental form of truth.

The apophantic logos is an ability (Vermögen) grounded in being free for beings as such; only where there is freedom is there the binding character of things, and so the possibility of the either/or of truth and falsity — the logos does not produce its relation to beings or their manifestness but only makes use of both.

The originary dimension of the logos is a fundamental occurrence of Dasein recorded in three moments: [1] holding the binding character of things toward oneself; [2] completion (the prior forming of the 'as a whole'); [3] unveiling the being of beings. These do not exhaust world-formation but belong essentially to it.

In every assertion, however trivial, we always already speak out of beings that are manifest 'as a whole' (the lecture theatre, not merely the badly-positioned board); ordinary understanding 'cannot see the world for beings' — the 'as a whole' is the pre-logical manifestness identified in §75 with the world.

The distinction between being and beings (the ontological difference) is not made by us but happens to us as the fundamental occurrence of our Dasein; it already has occurred whenever we experience beings in their being-such; it 'stands at the commencement of Dasein itself' and is the central moment from which the problem of world is comprehended.

Projection (Entwurf) is the primordial structure that originarily unifies the three moments: an originary, unique action that raises whoever projects away into the possible 'in its possibly being made possible'; projection lets the binding character spring forth, is intrinsically completing (forming an 'as a whole'), and is the irruption into the 'between' of being and beings in which the 'as' springs forth.

'Projection is world-projection. World prevails in and for a letting-prevail that has the character of projecting.' In the occurrence of projection world is formed: man irrupts as an actual being into the midst of what can now be manifest as beings — man as transition, as history, 'enraptured in this transition and therefore essentially absent', for whom terror and the bliss of astonishment (enthousiasmos) become possible.

Aristotle's synthesis-diairesis is shown by §76 to be precisely what projection necessarily had recourse to: projection takes-apart (diairesis) in raising away, yet in such a way that what is projected turns back and binds together (synthesis); it thereby 'intrinsically unites contradictory things: binding together and separating.'

interlocutors.name: Aristotle
interlocutors.role: Primary historical interlocutor of §72-73: De Interpretatione (Peri Hermeneias) on the logos apophantikos — semainein, kata syntheken / symbolon, apophansis, kataphasis/apophasis, onoma/rhema; De Anima III.6 (430a-b) and Metaphysics E.4 (1027b) on synthesis/diairesis and nous as the ground of true/false. 'Ancient reflection reaches its apotheosis in Aristotle.'

interlocutors.name: Kant
interlocutors.role: Invoked in §70 for the 'dialectical illusion' (Transcendental Dialectic) as foundation-laying for metaphysics, and in §72 as providing — centuries after Aristotle and consistently with him — the interpretation of the 'is' as not a real predicate but a positing / respectus logicus (1763 essay; Critique of Pure Reason, A592ff./B620ff.).

interlocutors.name: Hobbes
interlocutors.role: Cited in §72 (De corpore, Logica) for a theory of the copula that concentrates the meaning of subject and predicate upon one and the same thing (quid/quidditas), pointing the 'is' back toward the beings the assertion is about.

interlocutors.name: Lotze, Windelband, Rickert, Lask
interlocutors.role: Named in §72 as developing the theory of judgement toward validity/being-valid; in Rickert this becomes the approach to a value-philosophy. Heidegger judges all such theories one-sided for missing the undifferentiated manifold of the 'is'.

interlocutors.name: Hegel
interlocutors.role: Named as 'the last great metaphysician in Western metaphysics', for whom metaphysics coincides with logic as the science of reason; the foil for §74's claim that the world-problem must be set aside so long as metaphysics is 'Science of Logic'.

interlocutors.name: Plato
interlocutors.role: Named as exerting essential influence on Aristotle's insight into the structure of the statement, and for logos tinos (assertion-about); but reckoned among the 'provisional and extrinsic theories' Aristotle's radicalization surpassed.

interlocutors.name: Schelling
interlocutors.role: Borrowed-from in §76: projection as 'the look into the light of a possible making-possible' (Lichtblick ins Mögliche-Ermöglichende), after the Philosophische Untersuchungen über das Wesen der menschlichen Freiheit (1809).

interlocutors.name: Nietzsche
interlocutors.role: Invoked at the unit's close: the bliss of astonishment as enthousiasmos, 'witnessed by the last of the greats', via Zarathustra's 'intoxicated song' ('O Man! Attend! ... The world is deep') — 'in which we also experience what the world is.'

bridge_relevance: This unit gives the firmest textual ground for the King-Salvo bridge's core equation world = manifestness = disclosure. §67 returns the world-question explicitly to 'the direction disclosed by the interpretation of profound boredom', and §68 reaffirms that attunement makes beings as a whole manifest and makes Dasein manifest to itself — so the deepest structure of world-formation (projection, §76) is continuous with the disclosive work of the fundamental attunement analysed in Part One. For the empirical pipeline this anchors why a boring stimulus is treated as opening (or foreclosing) a manifestness 'as a whole' rather than registering a feeling-state: the apophantic-logos analysis (§§72-73) demotes propositional/measurable truth ('the assertion only takes apart what is already manifest') beneath a pre-predicative manifestness, exactly paralleling the bridge's surface/depth split between articulated report and the deeper attunement that EEG/gaze/phenomenology triangulate.
